summary: Make fixos cleanup safe: honor dry-run, truthful sizes, quoted commands

delivery.outcome: fixos cleanup never deletes in --dry-run, reports only space its commands can reclaim, never runs shell-split rm arguments or credential revocation, and reports Docker measurement failures instead of silently dropping Docker while scanning faster.
nonGoals: No change to Docker, Ollama, orphaned-project or network cleanup flows.
No new CLI option, output schema removal or runtime dependency.
No real deletion on the developer machine during validation.

architecture.decision: Thread dry_run through the interactive executors; drop the XDG state directory from the logs service because it holds application state, not disposable logs; quote multi-word cache paths and remove gcloud credential revocation from the cache command; accept du totals printed with a non-zero exit; cache a failed docker system df for the scan and expose it as a plan warning shown by the CLI.
architecture.rollback: Revert the implementation commit; cleanup commands, scan paths and interactive execution return to the previous behavior.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_cleanup_safety.py tests/unit/test_cleanup_cmd.py tests/unit/test_service_cleanup.py tests/unit/test_service_scanner.py tests/unit/test_cleanup_utils.py tests/unit/test_docker_network_cleanup.py
validation.evidence: 9 new tests in tests/unit/test_cleanup_safety.py fail on base 5b765f5 and pass on the fix; the 85 existing cleanup tests still pass; ruff reports no issues. A read-only `fixos cleanup --list` on the developer host finished in 172 s instead of 564 s (filesystem cache may account for part of the gain), shows the Docker timeout warning and reports 16.30 GB safe instead of 99.63 GB.

Full suite: 601 passed, 5 skipped, 16 deselected, 4 failed; the 4 failures are typo-detection tests in tests/unit/test_ask_and_nl_group.py that fail identically on the base commit (click 8.3.2 lacks click.exceptions.NoSuchCommand). Governance gate: GOV-PASS for base origin/main and head HEAD.
